routing_warnings.description: The message changes how labor totals are calculated from actual session counts rather than changing the supplied service schedule fields.
The client specifies that totals must be calculated from actual session counts rather than a uniform weekly pattern; this changes the labor-calculation mechanism, not support-sheet inclusion.
The message discusses the effect of corrected weeks, rates, and hours on salary totals rather than whether a salary and wages support sheet must be included.
The client directs that residual amounts use permitted categories such as travel and consumable supplies; this concerns budget-gap allocation rather than support-sheet inclusion.
The same source independently changes the displayed Annex B weeks-served field and should also be evaluated for that narrower document-field Requirement.
The instruction to use only permitted categories such as travel and consumable supplies governs residual budget allocation rather than the labor-calculation Requirement.
